security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, menvcfg CSR is always unconditionally instantiated (MachineLevel.scala:184) without any gating on U-mode presence. If a synthesis/config tool were to optimize away or disable the menvcfg CSR register file while U-mode remains active, the instruction-decode logic in NewCSR.scala (lines 1505-1523) that reads menvcfg.regOut.CBZE/CBCFE/CBIE to gate CBO instruction legality would sample undefined/X-state on the CSR read bus. This could cause the CBO-illegal-condition signals to be deasserted, allowing CBO.ZERO, CBO.CLEAN, CBO.FLUSH, and CBO.INVAL to execute in U-mode when they should raise illegal-instruction exceptions.
security_spec.summary: menvcfg CSR must be present whenever U-mode is active; if unconditionally instantiated CSR module is removed by optimization while U-mode stays enabled, the CBO instruction gate logic reads stale/undefined CSR bus state, potentially allowing unprivileged cache maintenance operations
